LanguageData.XTS_CategoriesSectionDesc: Switch whole groups of xenotypes in or out of trader stock. Individual xenotypes can then be ticked on or off in the list below.
LanguageData.XTS_IncludeArchiteDesc: Allow traders to sell xenogerms for xenotypes containing archite genes (e.g., Sanguophage). These are typically more expensive.
LanguageData.XTS_IncludeInheritableDesc: Allow traders to sell xenogerms for germline xenotypes (e.g., Impid, Yttakin). Implanting these creates 'naturalized' members recognized by ideology.
LanguageData.XTS_ImplantGermlineAsEndogenesDesc: When a trader-sold xenogerm for a germline xenotype is implanted, write its genes into the pawn's germline as endogenes instead of as xenogenes, replacing the previous germline genes (skin and hair colour are kept when the new xenotype doesn't set them). The pawn becomes a born member of that xenotype: children inherit the genes, and a later xenogerm implant adds to them instead of overwriting them. As with a born member, no xenogerm can be extracted from the pawn afterwards.\n\nRequires '{0}'.
LanguageData.XTS_IncludePlayerScenarioDesc: Allow traders to sell xenogerms for the custom xenotypes your scenario's starting colonists were created with. Xenotypes assembled in-game at the gene assembler are never sold.
LanguageData.XTS_XenotypesSectionDesc: Untick a xenotype to keep its xenogerm out of trader stock. Xenotypes greyed out here are switched off by one of the settings above; their own tick is remembered and comes back when that setting is re-enabled. Hover a xenotype for its description and price breakdown.
LanguageData.XTS_XenotypeBlockedBy: Not sold: '{0}' is switched off above.
LanguageData.XTS_XenotypePlayerScenario: Defined in your scenario, not by a mod or DLC
LanguageData.XTS_CustomXenotypeDesc: A custom xenotype your scenario's starting colonists were created with.
LanguageData.XTS_PricingSectionDesc: Adjust the market value formula for trader-sold xenogerms. Changes affect new xenogerms only.
LanguageData.XTS_BasePresetValueDesc: Base silver value added to all preset xenotype xenogerms. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerMetabolismDesc: Silver value added per point of absolute metabolism. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerComplexityDesc: Silver value added per point of genetic complexity. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_ValuePerArchiteDesc: Silver value added per archite gene. Default: {0}
LanguageData.XTS_CommonalitySectionDesc: How a trader picks which xenotypes its xenogerms are for. Chances are recomputed from the prices of everything currently sellable, so the choice applies to newly generated stock only.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyInversePriceDesc: Cheaper xenogerms are more common: each xenotype's chance is proportional to 1 divided by its price. Expensive archite xenogerms stay rare finds.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategySoftInversePriceDesc: Cheaper xenogerms are still more common, but the bias is gentler: each xenotype's chance is proportional to 1 divided by the square root of its price.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyPriceDesc: Pricier xenogerms are more common: each xenotype's chance is proportional to its price.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyBellCurveDesc: Mid-priced xenogerms are the most common: chances follow a bell curve centred on the median price of everything sellable, so the cheapest and the priciest are both rare.
LanguageData.XTS_StrategyUniformDesc: Every sellable xenotype is equally likely, regardless of price.
